newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold, silver prices end steady, uptrend seen.
newsitem.headline: India gold, silver prices end steady, uptrend seen.

text.p: Gold and silver opened higher on Wednesday the back of a recovery in the world market but remained steady at that level in limited activity, dealers said.

On Tuesday gold was down by five rupees per 10 gramme and silver was up by five rupees per kg. Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 150 rupees higher at 59,600 rupees per piece. They were down by 150 rupees per piece on Tuesday.
Arrivals of smuggled metals was disrupted by frequent seizures carried out by the customs department, traders said.
Physical demand ahead of the festival was low but traders were expecting fresh buying in the coming days and the sentiment was firm at the close of the session.
